name: jojo-creative-radar-cloudflare
description: Cloudflare-native advertising creative intelligence radar with a read-only ChatGPT MCP interface.

scripts.deploy: node scripts/unpack.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.validate: npm run validate:static && npm run type-check

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Required for dashboard write actions. Use a random secret of at least 32 characters; do not reuse a password.

ADMUSE_COOKIE.description: Optional Tencent admuse.qq.com authenticated Cookie. Leave blank for demo/manual import mode; never paste it into ChatGPT.
